properties.description: The first generated image is accepted as sufficient visual direction; finish the remaining design discussion in chat. Keep fixed toolbars with content-only scrolling, repository roots without a redundant Checks root, shared expand/collapse/filter icon buttons and a splitter. Put the same passed/failed icons used in results after the left tree item labels. The right pane shows the latest result only, with Results and Code tabs; Code uses the existing text editor for the selected check implementation. History browsing is deferred to a later MVP task. Agree how a shared result presentation shows useful diagnostics without each test building a custom UI, before development.
properties.title: Iterate on the Checks view update with image generation
